limitations: Bounded randomized agreement with a saved solver is not proof of semantic completeness.
rule: From the yellow (4) bar on a grid edge, number parallel lines by distance d moving away from that edge. Inside the bar's span: d%6 in {0,2} -> yellow, d%6 odd -> background (erasing blobs), d%6==4 -> green, and on those d%6==4 lines every non-background cell of the whole line also turns green (3). Everything else is unchanged.
scope: Supported: bar on top, bottom, left or right edge (row or column ladders); grid sides 10..30, independent width and height; bar length 2..9 placed away from the corners; background and blob colours sampled from {0,1,2,5,6,7,8,9} with the two distinct; multiple separated run-stack blobs covering about 15-42% of the grid; the ladder may start blank/yellow on any line count. Not supported: multiple bars, bars not on an edge, blobs of several colours, blobs touching the bar line, or blob colours 3/4. Fixtures are reproduced through an input_grid replay path. That path extracts latent parameters (bg, blob colour, bar side/start/length, blob cell list) from run-length-encoded fixture inputs and re-renders them with the same constructive renderer. Hand-writing the irregular blob masks as separate arguments was impractical.
constraints: Exactly one yellow bar, length >= 2, lying on one grid edge and shorter than that edge
Colours 3 and 4 never appear in blobs or background
Background is the strict majority colour (blob coverage <= 42%)
Blobs are separated from each other by at least one background cell (8-neighbourhood) and never occupy the bar line
Random scenes are retried (bounded) so at least one blob cell lies on a d%6==4 line outside the span, and at least one blob cell lies inside the bar span
Output always differs from input, because lines at d=2 always gain yellow (grid length >= 10)
known_limitations: Fixture reconstruction uses the input_grid replay option rather than explicit per-cell arguments. Default random generation never touches the fixtures.
Blob shapes are generic run stacks, not the exact organic style of the originals.
Only a single blob colour per scene is generated.
Random dimensions must be 10..30. Sampling raises if both ladder/blob interactions cannot be constructed in 40 attempts.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback

checks: Period-six ladder is measured from the bar edge in all four orientations
Green lines recolour blob cells outside the ladder span; odd lines erase within-span blobs
Random scenes must exercise both within-span and outside-span interactions
Requested background/blob colours remain distinct; invalid dimensions/bar spans rejected
1000 independent seeds 20000..20999 checked against saved solver
